tech.summary: OpenAI ne 5 November ko GPT-6 Cyber launch kiya — ek aisa model jo software ki kamzoriyan dhoond kar un ke working exploits bhi bana sakta hai. Is ne Firefox mein 81 pehle se unknown high-severity flaws dhoonde aur Linux kernel ki 1,724 vulnerabilities reproduce kar ke 948 ke exploits banaye. ExploitGym benchmark par is ka score 48.5% hai (GPT-5.6 Cyber ka 32.1%). OpenAI ne isay apne safety framework mein 'Critical' — sab se oonchi cybersecurity rating — di hai. Access sirf Daybreak Red ke approved customers ko milega, API aur Codex se.
tech.title: OpenAI ka GPT-6 Cyber — hacking seekhne wala AI, lekin sirf vetted defenders ko milega

tech.summary: Anthropic ne 5 November ko Claude mein Personal Finance beta launch kiya — users apne bank aur card accounts Plaid ke zariye link kar ke pooch sakte hain 'mera paisa is mahine kahan gaya?' ya 'kya main trip afford kar sakta hoon?' Access poori tarah read-only hai: Claude paisa move, manage ya invest nahi kar sakta, aur investment advice dene ke liye bhi design nahi hai. Beta sirf US mein Pro, Max aur Ultra plans par hai, 16 banks tak link ho sakte hain, 24 mahine ki transactions parh sakta hai — aur is mein na ads hain, na sponsored recommendations, aur ye chats models ko train karne ke liye use nahi hongi.
tech.title: Claude ab aap ka bank parh sakta hai — dekh sakta hai, chhoo nahi sakta

tech.summary: Google ne Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available kar diya — Gemini API aur Gemini for business par. Ab native video clips 10 ki bajaye 15 second tak ban sakte hain, multi-turn conversational editing se ek hi clip ko baat cheet mein edit kiya ja sakta hai, aur reference images (character, product, style) pehle se behtar follow hoti hain. Qeemat 30% kam kar ke 720p video ke liye $0.07 per second kar di gayi hai. Har output par SynthID watermark bhi lagta hai. Ye pehli dafa hai ke koi Gemini Omni model generally available hua hai.
tech.title: Google ka Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash — ab 15 second ki AI video, 30% sasti

tech.summary: Baidu ne 5 November ko ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base ke weights open kar diye — 280 billion parameters wala mixture-of-experts model jo har token par sirf 14 billion parameters activate karta hai. Ye 33.5 trillion tokens par train hua hai aur 1 million tokens tak ka context support karta hai. Weights Hugging Face par FP8 aur BF16 mein mil rahe hain, vLLM aur SGLang support ke saath. Lekin ye sirf ek raw base model hai — na fine-tuning, na post-training — aur is ki custom license EU, UK aur South Korea mein use ki ijazat nahi deti. Baidu ka kehna hai ke post-trained version jald aayega.
tech.title: Baidu ne ERNIE 5.5 Flash khol diya — 280 billion parameters, lekin shartein bhi sakht

tech.summary: OpenAI ne 4 November ko Images 2.6 launch kiya — ChatGPT, Codex aur API par. Ab users text prompt ya photo se animated GIF bana sakte hain, us ki speed badal sakte hain aur frame by frame edit kar sakte hain. Image generation 50% tez hone ka daawa hai, aur saved reference images ko @ se dobara use kiya ja sakta hai. API ke liye do models hain — tez Flare (low quality par 6 second mein image) aur detail-oriented Sunburst. Company ke mutabiq ChatGPT, Codex aur API par har hafte 4 billion se zyada images ban rahi hain.
tech.title: ChatGPT Images 2.6 — ab photos se GIF banao, aur image 50% tez bane

pakistan.summary: Hukumat ne Thursday ko petrol ki qeemat Rs9.41 per litre aur high-speed diesel ki Rs5.56 kam kar di — ye chauthe din musalsal kami hai. Ab petrol Rs352.59 aur diesel Rs382.25 per litre milega, 6 November se. OGRA ke notification ke mutabiq petrol par ab bhi Rs114 aur diesel par Rs100 per litre taxes aur duties lag rahe hain. Kami ke peeche 30 din ka arrangement hai jis mein oil refineries petroleum levy ka Rs15 billion ka bojh khud utha rahi hain. July se fuel prices daily basis par fix ho rahi hain.
pakistan.title: Petrol phir sasta — Rs9.41 kami, chauthe din musalsal relief

pakistan.summary: Pakistan Air Force ne Tuesday ko mulk ke pehle indigenously developed air-to-air missile Fa'az ka kamyab flight test kiya — JF-17 fighter jet se launch, video bhi jaari ki gayi. ISPR ke mutabiq missile mein state-of-the-art terminal guidance system hai jo lambi range par hawai ahdaaf ko nishana bana sakta hai. Ye NESCOM ke tehat banaya gaya hai; GIDS ki specifications ke mutabiq is ki range 100km se zyada aur speed Mach 3.5 hai (ISPR ne range ya speed confirm nahi ki). Ye ek mahine mein teesra bara missile test hai — pehle Fatah-2 ER aur Fatah-IV ER test ho chuke hain.
pakistan.title: Pakistan ne apna pehla air-to-air missile Fa'az test kar liya — JF-17 se launch

pakistan.summary: Pakistan ne SAFF Championship ke opener mein India ke khilaf 3-2 se haar khayi — Dhaka mein half-time par 3-0 peeche tha, phir stoppage time mein Najeebullah ka header aur Alamgir Ghazi ka shandaar overhead kick score 3-2 kar gaya, lekin equaliser na ho saka. India ke Suhail Ahmad Bhat ne do goals kiye, teesra Manglenthang Kipgen ne. Pakistan ko pehle half mein penalty bhi mili thi jo Shayek Dost ne miss kar di. Ab Pakistan ko semi-final ki umeed zinda rakhne ke liye Sunday 8 November ko Maldives se positive result chahiye.
pakistan.title: SAFF opener mein Pakistan ki India se 3-2 haar — akhri lamhon mein overhead kick bhi kaam na aaya

pakistan.summary: World Bank ki International Debt Report 2026 ke mutabiq Pakistan ka total external debt 2025 tak khatam hone wali dahai mein taqreeban dugna ho kar $135.1 billion tak pahunch gaya. Ye aaj Dawn ki front page khabar hai. Report batati hai ke mulk ne das saal mein kitna bahari qarz liya — aur ye number is waqt samne aaya hai jab hukumat petrol sasta kar ke awam ko relief de rahi hai, lekin qarz ka bojh ab bhi barh raha hai.
pakistan.title: Pakistan ka bahari qarz aik dahai mein taqreeban dugna — $135.1 billion

pakistan.summary: Pakistan mein 2026 ka 9th polio case Khyber district se report hua — 7 mahine ka bacha, Bara tehsil ke Mastak Union Council se. Is saal ke 9 cases mein se 7 Khyber Pakhtunkhwa se hain (3 Khyber, 3 Bannu, 1 North Waziristan) aur 2 Sindh se. Khyber ke teenon cases ka virus Afghanistan se genetically linked hai, jahan is saal 50 cases report hue hain. PM Shehbaz Sharif ne Thursday ko review meeting mein chaaron subon se mashawarat kar ke ek hafte mein comprehensive strategy banane ki hidayat di. 2-8 November ki qomi campaign Pakistan aur Afghanistan mein ek saath chal rahi hai.
pakistan.title: Polio ka 9th case — Khyber mein 7 mahine ka bacha, PM ne ek hafte mein strategy mang li

pakistan.summary: NCCIA ne Karachi ki Sharea Faisal par Voxtron Solutions call centre par chhapa maar kar 273 logon ko giraftar kar liya — jin mein 100 se zyada khawateen aur 42 nabaligh bhi shamil hain. Raid 4 November ko Kavish Crown Plaza ke qareeb hua; 339 laptops, 152 mobile phones aur 4 computers zabt hue. Ilzaam hai ke centre foreign nationals ko bank aur debt validation services ke naam par call kar ke un ki personal aur financial maloomat (Social Security Numbers, card details) nikalta tha aur phir merchant accounts se unauthorized transactions karta tha. PECA 2016 ke tehat case darj, 9 key suspects ka 2 din ka remand mil gaya. NCCIA ke mutabiq Karachi mein taqreeban 350 call centres is tarah ke scams mein involved hain.
pakistan.title: NCCIA ka Karachi mein bara raid — 273 giraftar, 'scam call centre' ka bhanda phoot gaya
